description: In session.rs, run_session contains the entire RFC 5321 session state machine as one function: command parsing, AUTH handling, STARTTLS stub, MAIL/RCPT/DATA processing, Sieve dispatch, header injection, and QUIT — all in one 700+ line async fn. This makes the control flow hard to follow, the function impossible to unit-test in isolation, and any change to one command risks accidentally touching another. Fix: extract each major command handler (handle_ehlo, handle_auth, handle_mail, handle_data, etc.) into separate functions, with run_session acting as a thin dispatcher.
title: smtp: run_session is a 700-line monolithic match loop
